name: Dantalion
source: Dantalion is the 71st of Solomon's 72 pillars. He holds the title Grand Duke of Hell and commands 36 legions. He is a Nephilim and a candidate to succeed the throne during Lucifer's slumber. He's part of Astaroth's faction.
